verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents real-time streaming that updates the app as features are changed or toggled, and a toggle endpoint can switch a flag off per environment. However, streaming is documented only through the GrowthBook Proxy and only for JavaScript and React, so the kill-switch guarantee does not extend to the other SDKs. missing for 10: streaming or fast-polling support for the non-JS SDKs, documented propagation latency ("seconds"), hands-on or independent corroboration that a toggle-off reaches connected SDKs promptly.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: Streaming - Updates your application in real-time as features are changed or toggled in GrowthBook (JavaScript and React only)
It turbocharges your GrowthBook implementation by providing speed, scalability, security, and real-time feature rollouts.
automate it (for example, from a deploy script) with the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
